concept.interaction: Two players abut southwest_panel, southeast_panel, northwest_panel and northeast_panel, set eight pieces each using the included key, then lift and replace celestial pieces on the orthogonal grid. The Dust knot can erase the Red giant, both ways; only Dust knots occupy dust lanes, and either team blocks the Comet and Pulsar leaps. Traps cancel rank and rival reference apertures end the contest.
concept.print_stance: 20 separate PLA parts, flat XY at Z0; 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, 220 mm cube bed.
concept.signature_decision: Distinct celestial sculptures express the dust-occultation exception, with exact game mechanics preserved rather than a badge-only rename.
concept.summary: A compact celestial Jungle Chess set with sculpted sky objects, tactile team shapes and the exact Leiden rules.
concept.title: Dustlight Crossing

design_changes.current: Four long river strokes, four short trap bars, single closed den frame and circle/square ownership marks; full coordinates and setup supplied in rules.
design_changes.previous: Curved double river contours, zero glyphs, coordinate and setup numerals, nested den outline.
design_changes.reason: Initial wall checks found fragile sub-nozzle ridges and tiny glyph islands; simplified engraving preserves flat pads, exact terrain and playable topology.
Remove unsupported thin lips while retaining distinct moon and asteroid form.
Keep every numeral inside the circular foot.

research.novelty: Bounded searches found no directly matching Dustlight Crossing game; no universal novelty or trademark clearance claim.
research.rights: Traditional game methods with original rules wording and geometry; no copied source artwork. No worldwide legal-clearance claim. Full bounded rights/popularity record in design handoff.
